subject: general
question: When we travel across the countryside, we see red soils in many regions. What is the reason for its colour?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Abundance of ferric oxides__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red Soil**

 
 
• The** color of red soil can range from red to brown, yellow, grey, and even black** in some circumstances. 
 
• Red soil has a relatively **high percentage of iron (Ferric ion)** in it, which is the reason for its color since **ferric oxide is reddish-brown in color**. 
 
• Common nutrients like** nitrogen, humus, phosphoric acid, lime, magnesium**, etc. are deficient in red soil.
 
• However, the **soil's pH ranges from neutral to acidic**, and it is relatively rich in **potash**.
 
• It forms as a result of the weathering of older crystalline and metamorphic rocks, primarily **acid granites, quartz rocks, gneiss, and felspathic rocks**.
 
• When it comes to its chemical makeup, red soil is primarily **siliceous and aluminous** with some free quartz present as sand, but it is also highly potassium-rich.
 
• Red soil is mostly **loamy**, but it can also contain sand and clay.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Red soil has two distinct layers: the l**ower part is dark in colour and rich in fertility, and the upper part is more sandy and porous**.
 
• Therefore, high production of different crops, including **cotton, millets, wheat, rice, oilseeds, pulses, tobacco, and fruits**, can be achieved with the proper use of fertilizers and irrigation.
 
• Red soil is a very valuable soil resource with significant implications for the development of **agriculture sustainably and the healthy expansion of the economy**.
 
• The color of any soil can be attributed to the** nutrients that are present in them**. 
 
• The **composition of oxides** with which the soil is made is one of the major factors that affect the color of the soil.
